name: Fathom Holdings Inc.

catalysts.headline: Fathom and Neighborhood Intelligence (NXH) announced a proposed restructured transaction to replace their June 16, 2026 merger agreement: NXH would contribute its ~38.8% stake in tZERO Group, Medici-related fund assets, and a GrainChain investment to Fathom for >=$130 million in newly issued Fathom shares; NXH expected to retain a controlling interest in Fathom post-close.
catalysts.impact: strongly positive (shares jumped in after-hours trading; magnitude disputed)

catalysts.headline: Q2 2026 results: revenue $114.6M (-6.0% YoY vs $121.4M); GAAP EPS -$0.19 (vs -$0.13 in Q2 2025); net loss $6.2M; transaction volumes down 13-15% YoY; agent count down ~30% due to strategic rationalization

Fathom Holdings entered a Merger Agreement and Plan of Reorganization with Bed Bath & Beyond, Inc. (subsequently renamed Neighborhood Intelligence, Inc.); implied FTHM equity value of ~$53.38 million; exchange ratio of 0.2236 BBBY shares per Fathom share; expected to close in 2H 2026 pending approvals. Replaced by the Sept 24, 2026 restructured transaction above.

Reported Q4 and full-year 2025 results: FY2025 revenue $420.5M (+25% YoY), FY2025 EPS -$0.72 (improved from -$1.07 in FY2024); Q4 2025 EPS -$0.21 (missed -$0.11 estimate), Q4 2025 revenue $90.6M (missed $97.55M estimate); total 2025 transactions up ~15% YoY

conflicts: Shares outstanding: ~32.8M (June 2026) vs ~34.21M ('current') vs ~30M (Sept 30, 2025) vs ~20M (2024) - heavy historical dilution, current count not fully reconciled
